summary: Full backend test suite for the Quintuple Discord bot: 11/11 pytest tests pass. Covered health, install-link, signature security (missing/invalid -> 401), valid PING -> PONG (via ed25519 keypair monkey-patched onto server.verify_key), full /use APPLICATION_COMMAND flow (returns type:4 with content + spawns 4 followups captured via monkey-patched send_followups, validating webhook URL & content), usage/stats math (messages = uses*5), usage/recent has no MongoDB _id leakage, and register-commands hitting real Discord successfully with integration_types=[0,1] contexts=[0,1,2].

minor.issue: Deprecated FastAPI on_event; migrate to lifespan handler.
Re-converts ISO timestamp string back to datetime in a loop after fetching — unnecessary since Pydantic will serialize either way; minor perf nit.

send_followups task created with asyncio.create_task is fire-and-forget; if the event loop is busy or worker is recycled mid-task, followups 2-5 may be dropped silently. Consider a background task queue or at minimum keep a strong reference set to prevent GC of the task.

action_items: Optional: keep strong reference to asyncio.create_task(send_followups(...)) to avoid potential GC of background followup task.
Optional: migrate @app.on_event('shutdown') to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
critical_code_review_comments: send_followups uses asyncio.create_task without retaining the task reference — Python may garbage-collect a running task in some scenarios. Recommend storing in a module-level set and discarding on done.
Signature verification happens correctly before JSON parsing — good security practice.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in usage_stats and usage_recent — verified no leakage in response body.
Pydantic models used for response validation (StatsResponse, UsageLog) — good.
All env vars accessed via os.environ[] (fail-fast) for required keys — good.
/use option parsing has a sensible default 'hello' if message option missing, but the command schema marks message as required — defensive coding is fine.
test_credentials: N/A - Discord token/public key already in /app/backend/.env. Test uses generated ed25519 keypair monkey-patched onto server.verify_key (in-process TestClient only); real env values untouched.
seed_data_creation: Test /use invocation inserts a usage_logs document with message='hello world' into MongoDB (test_database.usage_logs). Not cleaned up — harmless and used for stats verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests run via `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v`. Public endpoints (health, install-link, usage/*, signature 401 cases, register-commands) are tested against the deployed external URL. Signed interaction tests (PING/PONG and /use) use FastAPI TestClient in-process and monkey-patch server.verify_key + server.send_followups so no real Discord webhook calls are made. The real DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY in .env is never mutated.
